near_term_sprints.name: GUI_TRUTH_FUNCTION_REPORTING_AUDIT
near_term_sprints.objective: Inventory and reconcile the active GPI Hub GUI, every operator action, and all operational reporting against authoritative backend truth; remove or hide inaccurate, contradictory, duplicative, or unnecessary AP/Warehouse surfaces before cutover.
near_term_sprints.cutover_relevance: Misleading operator state is a parity risk and becomes a parity blocker when it can cause an incorrect action or conceal failed delivery.

notes: V100 REV4 preserves REV2 JSON/python runtime discovery and REV3 persistent failure capture. It handles only Mongo's exact anonymous /data/configdb volume: source path/name are verified, source contents are probed read-only, and the mount is mapped to dedicated target storage only when empty. Any content or any other unknown volume fails closed. No traffic cutover or Production writes are authorized. Near-term sprint queue now includes the GUI truth/function/reporting audit tracked by GitHub issue #17 immediately after V101 target parity validation.
